text: Lefina gets kidnapped by a monster! Filecia suspects that it\nhappens because of the sweets she makes. Collect the\ningredients for the sweets to investigate the cause!
The sweets made with the collected ingredients are different\nfrom those made using Filecia's recipe. Go to Creme Cliff to\nput these sweets as baits to lure the monster out!
A monster took the sweets you put as baits away!\nChase it and pin down its destination!
After following the monster, you discover that Lefina is being worshiped as a goddess. You must rescue her no matter what, so defeat the monster!
You defeat the monster and save Lefina.\nFor now, return to Sofya City!
